messages:
jess_p: WTF we just got flagged by legal / audit. Apparently retention for route `playback.inspect.v2` was bumped to 7d during last night's maintenance and that pulled a bunch of inspector captures with user identifiers into the daily archive. Anyone change retention?
mike_r: I rolled a config set for some routes but I explicitly excluded `playback.inspect.*`. Logs show a `config-sync` job at 6112345900 touched retention entries. Investigating whether templating matched wildcard unexpectedly.
anya: I reviewed the sync job: looks like a templated overlay applied `default_retention: 7d` to routes that didn't have an explicit retention. We assumed inspect routes had explicit TTLs 😬.
nora_ops: Immediate mitigation: we can enable the console toggle `Observability > Inspect > Global Redact Mode` to force redact-only ingestion for any inspect* route. That will stop raw payload persistence without touching current TTL values. I'll flip it in prod now.
jenkins-bot: [config-sync] overlay-apply -> SUCCESS at 6112345923 :white_check_mark:
jess_p: Please annotate the change with the incident #INC-1122 and include the audit reason. Legal wants a list of affected tenants and counts.
mike_r: I'll run a quick query against archive: `select tenant_id, count(*) from daily_archive where route like 'playback.inspect.%' and retained_days >= 1 group by tenant_id` and dump CSV. ETA 20m.
tom_s: For medium-term, let's add a router-side soft cap: ingress-proxy should drop payload bodies for inspect routes when retention budget exceeds X per-tenant per-hour and emit `inspect_body_dropped` metric with labels {tenant,route}. That way console will surface which tenants are over-budget.
anya: I can prototype a guarding middleware in 30m. Proposed config in ingress-config.yaml: `inspect_body_budget: { per_tenant_per_hour: 500, on_exceed: strip_body_emit_meta }`.
mike_r: Add an alert rule: when `inspect_body_dropped{env="prod"}` > 0 for > 5m, create page to oncall and add slack message to #incidents. We missed signal last time.
nora_ops: Also suggest small UX safety: any retention or redact toggle that affects >1 env must show an explicit list of target envs and require typed confirmation (type the route prefix). That would've prevented the wildcard slip.
jess_p: Agreed. Also could we make 'apply retention' create a dry-run preview showing samples of routes and estimated delta in storage per day? Very helpful.
tom_s: For rollback: add console action `revert-last-retention-change` that calls orchestration API. The API should run a dry-run to detect any PII exposures before applying revert.
deploy-bot: [config-toggle] global-redact-mode -> PROD enabled by nora_ops at 6112346005 :warning:
mike_r: CSV uploaded to the incident thread. Sending to legal and support to triage affected customers.
anya: Opened PR: https://git.company/infra/ingress/pulls/1299 implementing `inspect_body_budget` + metric emission.
jess_p: Follow-up tickets: UX-334 (modal confirm + preview), OPS-221 (ingress guard + metric), LEGAL-1122 (affected tenant report). I'll file and link.
nora_ops: Thanks team. Let's schedule a short postmortem and lock defaults so inspect routes default to redact-only unless explicitly opt-in with documented justification.
jess_p: Agreed. Closing immediate actions. We'll post a summary in #all-hands later.
